_note: The readiness report's skill map (spec §3, §9). DATA, not code. Each skill is demonstrated ONLY by its `evidence` (a gate task id or a case id) passed without help. `practice` lists the lessons whose drills count as practice for it; practice alone never demonstrates a skill. `claim` is the CV/interview-safe wording once demonstrated; `helped` is what to say when the evidence was passed with help; `gap` is what to say (and do) until then.

skills.label: Cell references, ranges and $ locks
skills.claim: Comfortable navigating a sheet and writing formulas with relative and absolute ($) references.
skills.helped: Familiar with cell references and $ locks.
skills.gap: Pass the Level 0 checkpoint before claiming basic formula fluency.

skills.label: Conditional totals and counts: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF, IFERROR
skills.claim: Summarise and conditionally aggregate transactional data with SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF and IFERROR.
skills.gap: Don't list SUMIFS/COUNTIFS yet: pass Assignment 1 (Sales summary) first.

skills.label: Lookups: VLOOKUP (exact and approximate), XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH
skills.claim: Join tables with VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP and INDEX/MATCH, including approximate-match bands and lookups inside calculations.
skills.gap: Don't claim VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH yet: pass Assignment 2 (Enrich the order log) first.

skills.label: Data cleaning: duplicates, blanks, TRIM/PROPER, text to number, Find & Replace
skills.claim: Clean raw exports: remove duplicates, fill blanks from a reliable source, standardise text, fix numbers stored as text and typos.
skills.gap: Don't claim data cleaning yet: pass Assignment 3 (From messy export to one-slide answer).

skills.label: Pivot tables: build, group dates, filter, % of total, refresh
skills.claim: Build pivot tables: group dates, filter, show values as % of total, and refresh after the data changes.
skills.gap: Don't claim pivot tables yet: pass Assignment 3.

skills.label: Charts and a one-sentence insight
skills.claim: Choose the right chart, title it with the finding, and state the insight in one sentence.
skills.gap: Don't claim data storytelling yet: pass Assignment 3.

skills.label: End to end: messy export → cleaned, enriched, pivoted, checked against targets → finding
skills.claim: Take a messy sales export to a short, correct finding for a manager, including performance against target.
skills.helped: Worked through an end-to-end sales review case study, with help.
skills.gap: Do Case A (Q3 sales review) before describing end-to-end analysis work.

skills.label: A mixed practical Excel test under a 45-minute limit
skills.claim: Sit a timed, mixed practical Excel test (lookups, conditional aggregates, cleaning, pivots) and finish it correctly within 45 minutes.
skills.helped: Passed a timed mock Excel test on a variant whose answer key I had seen.
skills.gap: Pass the mock hiring test cold before saying you're ready for a timed Excel test.

outOfScope: Dynamic arrays (FILTER, UNIQUE, SORT) and IFS/SWITCH
Advanced charting and dashboards beyond one chart
fallback: Strong on data prep and analysis; actively building advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivots) through graded practice.
